issue_context.title: add support for multi-channel (>4) TIFs.
issue_context.body:
### System Information

[DaVinci-Resolve-Logo.tif.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18261560/DaVinci-Resolve-Logo.tif.zip)

```
[INFO] Importing image...
[ERROR:0@0.014] global loadsave.cpp:440 imread_ imread_('/Users/fractale/Downloads/DaVinci-Resolve-Logo.tif'): can't read header: OpenCV(4.9.0) /Users/fractale/.conan2/p/b/openc62c1fdd986bb3/b/src/modules/imgcodecs/src/grfmt_tiff.cpp:150: error: (-2:Unspecified error) in function 'int cv::TiffDecoder::normalizeChannelsNumber(int) const'
> Unsupported number of channels:
>     'channels >= 1 && channels <= 4'
> where
>     'channels' is 5

[ERROR] Could not open input image file: /Users/fractale/Downloads/DaVinci-Resolve-Logo.tif
```

OpenCV doesn't support multi-channel (>4) TIFs.
comments:
with changing
`CV_Check(channels, channels >= 1 && channels <= 4, "Unsupported number of channels");` to
`CV_Check(channels, channels >= 1 && channels <= 5, "Unsupported number of channels");`  [grfmt_tiff.cpp](https://github.com/opencv/opencv/blob/4.x/modules/imgcodecs/src/grfmt_tiff.cpp#L146)
and
`CV_CheckLE((int)ncn, 4, "");` to
`CV_CheckLE((int)ncn, 5, "");` [grfmt_tiff.cpp](https://github.com/opencv/opencv/blob/4.x/modules/imgcodecs/src/grfmt_tiff.cpp#L146)
it is possible to read 
```
    Mat color = imread("c:/images/DaVinci-Resolve-Logo.tif",IMREAD_COLOR);
    Mat gray = imread("c:/images/DaVinci-Resolve-Logo.tif",IMREAD_GRAYSCALE);
```
when
`Mat unchanged = imread("c:/images/DaVinci-Resolve-Logo.tif",IMREAD_UNCHANGED);`
getting
```
[ERROR:0@0.015] global loadsave.cpp:507 cv::imread_ imread_('c:/images/DaVinci-Resolve-Logo.tif'): can't read data: OpenCV(4.12.0-dev) C:\projects\opencv\modules\imgcodecs\src\grfmt_tiff.cpp:915: error: (-2:Unspecified error) in function 'bool __cdecl cv::TiffDecoder::readData(class cv::Mat &)'
> TIFF-8bpp: BGR/BGRA images are supported only (expected: 'wanted_channels == 3'), where
>     'wanted_channels' is 5
> must be equal to
>     '3' is 3
```
If the core developers like this limited support someone can prepare a PR
below is the result image of `Mat color = imread("c:/images/DaVinci-Resolve-Logo.tif",IMREAD_COLOR);` after mentioned changes
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/66e49053-3c13-496d-806d-1656eac08d8c)

review_comments:
OpenCV expects up to 4 channels for images, e.g. RGB/BGR + Alpha.
Open questions:
- Default imread output is BGR. It's not clear how to treat 5 channel tiff in this case?
- Why 5, but not 6, 8 or 16?
I initially chose 5 channels to avoid potential computational overhead, but I’ll work on extending support and providing clear results. Thank you
